name: Fishing Rod
description: Guidelines for traveling with fishing rod in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Fishing rods are allowed in carry-on if they fit within airline overhead dimension limits. Sharp hooks and lures must be checked.

checkedBag.reason: Fishing rods and reels are allowed in checked baggage.

travelTips: Fishing rods are allowed in carry-on if they fit within airline overhead dimension limits. Sharp hooks and lures must be checked.

faq.question: Is fishing rod allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Fishing Rod is allowed in carry-on luggage. Fishing rods are allowed in carry-on if they fit within airline overhead dimension limits. Sharp hooks and lures must be checked.

faq.question: Can you pack fishing rod in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Fishing Rod is allowed in checked bags. Fishing rods and reels are allowed in checked baggage.
